title: 瑞银王蔚：银行盈利改善，派息率提升，多元化配置正当时
speaker: James Wang

segments.en: And if I look at the basic material sector, earnings upgrades have been to the tune of 20, 30% year-to-date, share price of that act. So, I think these could also benefit as well. And also, we are quite like the banks, because of the improving earnings growth outlook, as well as the fact that they're starting to increase the power ratio, which is something we haven't seen for a very long time for the banks.
segments.zh: 基础材料板块年初至今盈利上修达20-30%，股价也有所反应。我们也看好银行，因为盈利增长前景改善，而且它们开始提高派息率，这是很久没见过的。

segments.en: There seems to be, after what happened in July, everyone's kind of concerned about, we need to kind of diversify away from the whole hardware space, right? Is the banking sector the way you do it? What else could you do? That's the one. That's the one, I think. That's very much uncorrelated with the AI trade.
segments.zh: 7月之后，大家担心需要从硬件领域分散配置。银行是方式之一吗？还有其他选择吗？我认为银行是很好的选择，它与AI交易相关性很低。

segments.en: We had, for example, Power Equipment, in our portfolio, and we realized, actually, it's exactly the same trade as hardware tech. So, we took it out, because I think the market does want to diversify. Also, I'd say, some of the upstream sectors, also less of a more of a macro trade or financial trade, rather than the tech trade.
segments.zh: 比如我们组合里曾有电力设备，但发现它与硬件科技交易完全相同，所以剔除了。市场确实需要分散。一些上游板块更多是宏观或金融属性，而非科技属性。

segments.en: And also, we're like some of the industrial names, particularly those that are going overseas in China, that are getting market share and moving up the valley chain. So, those are the sectors that we like.
segments.zh: 我们还看好一些工业股，特别是那些出海的中国企业，它们正在获得市场份额并提升价值链。这些是我们看好的板块。
